title: render.get_thumbnails
description: Render 'count' equally spaced frames over the TimeRange 'range' (contact-sheet sampling for content-aware scanning). 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.6 render.get_thumbnails; the legacy 'scan_timeline' (timeline range) and 'make_contact_sheet' (footage range) tools were merged into this single face by choosing the target.

footage.description: Raw media target (exactly one of sequence/footage).

range.description: Sampling interval on the target timeline, left-closed right-open.

in.description: Time value. Exactly two accepted forms: (a) rational seconds {num, den} (OPP/1 section 5 Rational - the only wire form of the protocol), or (b) a non-negative integer frame index on the target frame grid. Bare floating-point seconds such as 1.5 are rejected by design; a frame rate like 29.97 must be written as {num: 30000, den: 1001}.

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.

out.description: Time value. Exactly two accepted forms: (a) rational seconds {num, den} (OPP/1 section 5 Rational - the only wire form of the protocol), or (b) a non-negative integer frame index on the target frame grid. Bare floating-point seconds such as 1.5 are rejected by design; a frame rate like 29.97 must be written as {num: 30000, den: 1001}.

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.

count.description: Number of equally spaced samples; hard cap 64 (OPP/1 section 8.6).

height.description: Thumbnail height in pixels; defaults to 180 (OPP/1 section 8.6).

allOf.description: Render target: exactly one of 'sequence' (timeline frame) or 'footage' (raw media frame). OPP/1 section 8.6 requires one of the two and returns INVALID_PARAMS when both are missing; T0 also rejects 'both present' because the protocol leaves that case unspecified (open item, see method-map.md).

oneOf.description: Timeline frame: render the composed sequence.
Raw media frame: render one footage file.
